sections.synopsis: A shallow intrusion of magma is occurring within the summit region near the existing eruption location in Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.

Intermittent overflows and spatter from both north and south vents occurred over the past day Halema'uma'u crater at the summit of Kīlauea. West vent had occasional glow overnight. There is no anomalous activity outside of the summit.

No overflows or spattering at north or south vents over the past day; strong glow and flames continue. No reactivation of intrusion emplaced two nights ago. Earthquake activity continues underneath Halemaʻumaʻu. No anomalous activity outside the summit.
